title: Unit Event — The Way I Played That Day — Episode4 Revisiting The Past

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day
meta.Event Outline: Kanade continues to write songs in the hope of saving Mafuyu. When her grandmother calls to suggest that she think more about herself and her own future, her thoughts turn toward the past.

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI
Lake

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can hear music coming from that lake again today...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's a song that I composed for N25...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When did I work on this one?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't think we'd met each other in person yet. Now I'm starting to feel all this nostalgia...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Back then, I was so desperate about composing a song that could save someone.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So desperate that I started eating and sleeping less, which worried Ms. Mochizuki a lot.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, all I've been doing is composing songs...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That's true now, but also before I even formed N25.)
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is something wrong?
You seem to have a lot on your mind today...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you worried about Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, actually, I've been thinking about myself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yourself?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes... But my problems are small compared to Mafuyu's, so there's no need for you to worry.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I kinda want to hear what's going on with you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna help Mafuyu, but I also wanna help you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, thank you...
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What does music mean to you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I've been wondering that for a little while now, but can't seem to find the answer...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All I had been thinking about was composing songs that can save people. That's what I thought I had to do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But now, I'm wondering if I should be feeling something else...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's where I'm stuck.
I don't know what I should be feeling...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why did you start composing songs, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Why? Because...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because of my dad...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your dad?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I really love the songs he composed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They were happy, gentle and always made my mom smile.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also...
A dozen or so years earlier
Kanade's Father's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I should probably drop the tempo here a little. And then...

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Huh...? Kanade, you're in your father's room again. How many times do I have to tell you that he's working?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Haha. That's fine, dear.
I'll feel more motivated knowing that she's watching.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Yes. Actually, I'm nearly done working on this song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Would you like to hear it?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Okay, I'll play a part of it. Ready...?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This song's so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: That's amazing, Daddy! You're like a wizard!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Haha. I'm not as amazing as you think I am. However, if you like it that much, then this song's sure to become a big hit.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah! I bet everyone's gonna really, really love it!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Daddy, can you show me how to make songs like this one?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade, would you like to learn how to make music?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Because Daddy's songs always make you, me and everyone else smile, Mommy!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
Then, I promise to show you when you're a little older.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you, Daddy!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I loved watching him create, which is why I spent so much time sitting next to him.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And then, that day...
